items.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton "praying" for Ferrari power unit after Mexico FP2 failure
items.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton retired early from second practice for the Formula 1 Mexico Grand Prix after his Ferrari power unit suddenly lost power, saying he is left "praying" over it.
detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在墨西哥站二练动力单元故障后“祈祷”法拉利动力单元无恙
这位法拉利车手因引擎故障在墨西哥大奖赛第二节练习赛中仅跑了28分钟
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在法拉利动力单元导致他在F1墨西哥大奖赛第二节练习赛中提前退赛后，只能“祈祷”其无恙。
这位七届世界冠军在第28分钟沿起点-终点直道行驶时突然失去动力，随后在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道3号弯出口处停车。
汉密尔顿在那之前一直享受着有竞争力的第二节练习赛，他在硬胎上最快，并跻身前五，最终在最终排行榜上跌至第11位。
但对法拉利车队来说，这仍是积极的一天，因为汉密尔顿的队友夏尔·勒克莱尔在周五的两节练习赛中均名列榜首，进入周六的第三节练习赛和排位赛。
“我在车里感觉真的很好，”汉密尔顿说。“只是我的运气不好。我们在把调校调整到更好的状态方面做得非常出色，是的，这真的很不幸。
“我认为这个周末我们作为一支车队真的很有竞争力，但没能完成长距离跑。所以我不知道怎么回事，但我知道在这里超车真的很难。正如你看到有些人在外面那样。
“所以他们仍在调查，以找出问题所在，并祈祷一切正常。”
这位41岁的车手认为，引擎故障让他处于“被动局面”，因为他在第一节自由练习的前半段一直用空气动力学测量架测试他的SF-26赛车，仅完成了25圈。
但许多其他车手在周五的开局也很缓慢，因为有10名“新秀”参加了首节练习，而法拉利是唯一没有派出年轻车手的车队。
“我在第一节自由练习中损失了一点时间，因为我们进行了测量架测试，”汉密尔顿补充道。
“通常我会像大多数人那样，让一位年轻车手在这条赛道上跑第一节练习赛。但我选择在其他地方做这件事。
“所以基本上我只真正跑了一节，因为我错过了那节至少一半的时间。所以，我的意思是，我不太清楚我们会处在什么位置。
“我觉得不需要对调校做太多改动。我大概想保持原样，因为我们非常快。
“我觉得在那一圈早些时候我已经损失了一些动力，而我们仍然很快。所以，是的，明天我会全力以赴，尽我所能用好现有的一切。”
“但很明显，我们感觉已经接近能够争夺头排发车位了。”
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton "praying" for Ferrari power unit after Mexico FP2 failure
The Ferrari driver contested just 28 minutes in second practice for the Mexico GP due to an engine failure
Lewis Hamilton has been left “praying” for his Ferrari power unit after it caused an early retirement in second practice for the Formula 1 Mexico Grand Prix.
The seven-time world champion suddenly lost power down the start-finish straight after 28 minutes, leading to him stopping at the exit of Turn 3 at Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez.
Hamilton was enjoying a competitive FP2 until then as he was quickest on the hard tyre and sat amongst the top five, before eventually dropping to 11th in the final leaderboard.
But it was still a positive day for the Scuderia, as Hamilton’s team-mate Charles Leclerc topped both Friday practice sessions heading into FP3 and qualifying on Saturday.
“I was feeling really good in the car,” said Hamilton. “It's just my luck. We did a really good job in getting the set-up in a better place and yeah, it's just really unfortunate.
“I think we're really competitive this weekend as a team and then didn't get to do the long run. So I have no idea how, but I know it's really hard to overtake here. As you saw some people out there.
“So they're still investigating to find out what was wrong and just praying that everything's OK.”
The 41-year-old reckons the engine failure has left him on the “back foot” because he spent the first half of FP1 with an aero rake on his SF-26, completing just 25 laps.
But many others also had a slow start to Friday as 10 ‘rookies’ contested opening practice, with Ferrari being the only team that didn’t field a young driver.
“I missed a little bit of time in FP1 because we did the rake running,” added Hamilton.
“Normally I would have one of the young drivers do FP1 at this track like most people did. But I opted to do it somewhere else.
“So basically I've only really had one session, because I missed pretty much at least half of that session. So, I mean, I don't really know where we would sit.
“I don't think I need to make many changes to the set-up. I probably want the same because we were very quick.
“I think I already had a loss of power earlier on in the lap and we're still quick. So, yeah, I'll give it everything tomorrow and just try to do the best with whatever I have.
"But it obviously feels like we could be close to competing for the front row.”

items.originalTitle: F1 fans rush to defend Isack Hadjar after controversial Mexican GP incident
items.summaryEn: Red Bull driver Isack Hadjar was summoned to the stewards for alleged misconduct during the Mexican Grand Prix weekend after footage showed him pushing away a fan trying to take a selfie, and F1 fans have since rushed to his defence.
detailZh: 车迷为哈贾尔辩护：墨西哥站争议事件
这名红牛车手因视频显示他推开一名车迷，必须前往墨西哥城大奖赛赛会干事处。
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与比赛分析。
红牛车手伊萨克·哈贾尔因在墨西哥大奖赛周末被指行为不当而被传唤至赛会干事，F1车迷随后纷纷为他辩护。此前有视频拍到他推开一名试图与他自拍的车迷。
周五，这段视频在社交媒体上迅速传播，画面似乎显示哈贾尔推开了一名粉丝，该粉丝正扑向这位车手，试图与他合影。在视频中，这名粉丝在哈贾尔走过围场时试图搂住他。车手用手臂将他挡开，随后在这名执着的粉丝继续纠缠时用力推了他一把。
此事发生在周五的两节练习赛之间。第一节练习赛对哈贾尔来说很艰难，他因动力单元问题而受限，无法跑更多圈数。他最终排名第11快，但在第二节练习赛结束时，他的成绩提升到了第六位。
虽然少数人批评哈贾尔对粉丝的反应，但也有不少人支持他。
“所以，令人难以置信的是，当你对他礼貌、不侵犯他的空间、不触碰他时，他对粉丝其实真的很酷……能见到一位车手是一种荣幸，但你永远没有资格要求它，”一位用户在X上写道，该帖子获得了超过3000个赞。
另一位补充道：“说实话，哈贾尔做得对，车迷们该收敛点了。个人空间是存在的，应该受到尊重。”
一些人质疑为什么是哈贾尔面对赛事干事。
一位车迷发帖说：“哈贾尔不该有麻烦，这个年纪更大的人不该碰他。围场是工作场所，不是表演场。车手是人，不是财产。”
其他人同意他的看法，但觉得这种情况本可以处理得更好。
“马克斯说得对，这简直像个动物园。人们根本不尊重车手的个人空间和边界。但这件事或许本可以处理得更好一些。安保人员应该更早介入，”另一位写道。
并非所有人都如此宽容，一位用户问道：“我们是在假装这……没问题吗？”
这起事件发生前几天，拉尔夫·舒马赫对德国天空体育表示，哈贾尔“需要收敛一点”，此前他在奥斯汀的无线电通讯中愤怒发言。
哈贾尔定于当地时间周六上午10点15分面见赛事干事。违反行为不当规则的基础罚款为5000欧元，不过初犯也有可能仅受到警告。
detailEn: F1 fans rush to defend Isack Hadjar after controversial Mexican GP incident
The Red Bull driver must see the Mexico City Grand Prix stewards after footage showed him pushing away a fan
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

Formula 1 fans have jumped to the defence of Isack Hadjar after the Red Bull driver was summoned to the stewards for alleged misconduct during the Mexican Grand Prix race weekend. This comes after he was filmed pushing a fan as they tried to get a selfie with the driver.

The video spread quickly on social media on Friday, appearing to show Hadjar pushing away a fan who was launching himself at the driver in an attempt to get a photo with him. In the footage, the fan attempts to put his arm around Hadjar as he walks through the paddock. The driver pushed him back at arm's length before giving him a forceful shove as the relentless fan continued.

This took place between the two practice sessions on Friday. FP1 was a struggle for Hadjar, who suffered from power unit problems limiting his runtime. He finished 11th fastest, but jumped up the timesheets to sixth by the end of FP2.
While a few have criticised Hadjar for his response to the fan, several have stood by him.

“So, incredibly, when you’re polite to him and don’t infringe on his space and touch him, he’s actually really cool to fans… it’s a privilege to meet a driver but you’re never entitled to it,” one user wrote on X, in a post liked more than 3,000 times.
Another added: “Good on Hadjar, honestly, fans should get a grip. Personal space is a thing and it should be respected.”
Some questioned why Hadjar was the one facing the stewards.
“Hadjar should not be in trouble, this OLDER man should not be touching him. Paddocks are workplaces, not show grounds. Drivers are people, not property,” one fan posted.
Others agreed with him but felt the situation could have been handled better.

“Max is correct, it’s like a zoo. People have no respect for drivers' personal space and boundaries. But it probably could have been handled a little better. Security should have stepped in sooner,” wrote another.
Not everyone was so forgiving, with one user asking: “Are we pretending this is… okay?”
The incident comes days after Ralf Schumacher told Sky Deutschland that Hadjar “needs to take it down a notch” following his angry radio messages in Austin.
Hadjar is due to see the stewards at 10.15am local time on Saturday. A breach of the misconduct rule carries a base fine of €5,000, although a warning is also possible for a first offence.

items.originalTitle: Isack Hadjar summoned to Mexico GP stewards for "misconduct" in F1 paddock
detailZh: 伊萨克·哈德贾被墨西哥大奖赛 stewards 召集，涉嫌 F1 赛道不当行为。
红牛车手伊萨克·哈德贾在墨西哥大奖赛赛道发生的不当行为被召唤至 stewards。
哈德贾在 FP1 赛段后，因被粉丝拍照而两次被愤怒的哈德贾推开。
事件发生在 Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez 赛道。
“国际汽联国际体育章程第12.2.1.l条款的违规行为——不当行为，与今天在一级方程式维修区发生的事件有关，” stewards报告读道。
这发生在周五两场练习赛之间，哈贾尔在首场一个小时的比赛中感到失望，仅以11名完赛，比法拉利领跑者勒克莱尔慢1.417秒。
哈贾尔受到动力单元问题的困扰，这导致他只完成了21圈，这是第三低的总数，仅次于阿斯顿·马丁的Jak Crawford和奥迪的Freddie Slater。
不过，FP2的情况略有改善，因为哈贾尔以第六名完赛，比再次领跑的勒克莱尔慢0.410秒，队友维斯塔潘获得第五名。
detailEn: Isack Hadjar summoned to Mexico GP stewards for "misconduct" in F1 paddock
The Red Bull driver shoved away a fan who was attempting to take a selfie
Isack Hadjar has been summoned to the Formula 1 Mexico Grand Prix stewards for an alleged incident of “misconduct” in the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez paddock.
The Red Bull driver had been approached by a fan attempting to take a picture, but he was shoved away twice by a furious Hadjar after his disrupted FP1 session.
“Alleged breach of Article 12.2.1.l of the FIA International Sporting Code - Misconduct, relating to an incident in the Formula 1 paddock today,” read the stewards report.
It happened in between both Friday practice sessions with Hadjar suffering disappointment in the opening one-hour outing, finishing just 11th and 1.417s off Ferrari pacesetter Charles Leclerc.
Hadjar was plagued by power unit problems, which caused him to complete just 21 laps, and that was the third-lowest total ahead of Jak Crawford (Aston Martin) and Freddie Slater (Audi).
The situation did slightly improve in FP2 though, as Hadjar finished sixth and 0.410s behind Leclerc, who was again on top, with team-mate Max Verstappen claiming fifth.

国际汽联 stewards 召唤了红牛车手哈迪尔，要求其就"Formula 1维修区事件中的不当行为"进行说明。
召唤并未具体说明哈迪尔被召唤的原因。
社交媒体上流传的一段视频似乎显示哈迪尔推了试图与他合影的人。然而，这是否是哈迪尔于当地时间周六上午10:15被召唤见 stewards 的原因尚不清楚。
根据国际汽联的国际体育规则，"任何对国际汽联、其机构、其成员或其执行官员造成道德伤害或损失的字词、行为或书写，以及更普遍的关于赛车运动利益和国际汽联所捍卫的价值"可能被处以最高5000欧元的罚款。
在其他情况下，可以处以最高20000欧元的罚款，国际汽联的体育规则指出："对于非常严重的违规行为，根据国际体育规则[ISC]可以实施更严厉的处罚。"
然而，加重或减轻的情况可能会改变所施加的处罚。
detailEn: Isack Hadjar has been summoned by the stewards after alleged misconduct in the Formula 1 paddock at the Mexican Grand Prix.
The FIA stewards called the Red Bull driver to see them for "misconduct relating to an incident in the Formula 1 paddock".
The summons does not specify why Hadjar has been summoned.

A video has circulated on social media appearing to show Hadjar pushing someone who tried to take a selfie with him. It is however unclear whether this is the reason Hadjar has been called to see the stewards at 10.15am local time on Saturday.

As per the FIA's International Sporting Code, "any words, deeds or writings that have caused moral injury or loss to the FIA, its bodies, its members or its executive officers, and more generally on the interest of motorsport and on the values defended by the FIA" can carry a fine of up to €5000.
Fines of up to €20,000 can be applied in other cases and the FIA's sporting code says: "For very serious offences, more severe penalties under the ISC [international sporting code] may be imposed."
Aggravating or mitigating circumstances can however change the penalty imposed.
